changeSet.author: englishfriend
changeSet.sql: create materialized view if not exists mv_weekly_user_summary as select u.id as user_id, date_trunc('week', s.started_at) as week, count(distinct s.id) as sessions_cnt, avg(f.overall_grammar) as avg_grammar, avg(f.overall_pronunciation) as avg_pron from users u left join sessions s on s.user_id = u.id left join feedback f on f.session_id = s.id where s.started_at >= now() - interval '8 weeks' group by 1,2;
changeSet.rollback: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_weekly_user_summary;
